name: Symbol of Idiocy
body:
School necromancy; Level cleric/oracle 7, death mage 7, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7
Components V, S, M

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like symbol of death, except that every creature within 60 feet of a symbol of idiocy instead suffers crippling mental weakness that deals 3d6 points of Intelligence damage.

Unlike symbol of death, symbol of idiocy has no hit point limit; once triggered, a symbol of idiocy simply remains active for 10 minutes per caster level. A creature can only be affected by this symbol once.
